name: Andrew McGreevy
memory: Every visit to the Prisuta house, Wesley amazed me with how strong and full of life he was. Through everything, he was enjoying every moment and soaking up every ounce of joy with his family.

name: Nat Giuffre
memory: I will always remember Wesley’s sweet smile and sparkling eyes every time I saw him. I cherish all the times I got to hold him and make him giggle. I loved watching him laugh at his siblings and love on Meg and Matt.

name: Gigi
memory: I remember walking into the playroom one day, and Wesley was bouncing in the jumper that hung from the doorway. He was as happy as could be and taking in all the activity around him with the cutest look on his face🥰His snuggles on my shoulder I still feel to this day❤️Every moment spent with our sweet Wes would bring sheer joy .. his adorable dimple smile .. his beautiful gaze into nature and the heavens .. his giggles and laughs with his family .. his precious praying hands 🙏 Thank you, God, for the gift of this angel who will live on in our hearts forever 💙🪽

name: Timothy Robert McGreevy
memory:
“Wes” Wesley Robert Prisuta

Fighter
Chill Guy
Chubby cheeks 
Great smile 
He Cried first time I was left alone with him as soon as Mom left 
I don’t like to pick up babies they are too precious what if I dropped one .. I thought
Praying hands 🙏  so cute
“Happy to be here”
Just looking around
Happy and content
Smiling looking around
And him laughing was adorable
He fought hard
He brought us together in prayer and faith
A baby shouldn’t have had to go through what he went through. 

Jesus said Heaven is in you. I believe a little piece of Heaven is in you . I think Wesley had a bigger piece of Heaven in him than others. Wes brought us all together in faith and prayer for the long time he was in hospital and fighting. 

We are here for you. He is with us still.
Our relationship with Wesley is not over it’s only different… and when we reunite again it will be beautiful.

You are deeply missed but always remembered in our hearts. 

Love , 
Uncle Timmy Robert

name: The Gelsomino Fam
memory: Wesley had the sweetest face; a little glow about him from the beginning.  He loved watching everything move around him and was such a little observer. Our time with him will always feel so special and we will always feel so so lucky we got to know his strong heart.
